items.question: How many articles does the UAE Federal Law No. 6 of 2018 on Arbitration contain?
items.fact: UAE arbitration law No. 6 of 2018 has 61 articles.

items.question: What is the default language for proceedings at the Abu Dhabi Commercial Conciliation and Arbitration Centre?
items.gold: Arabic, unless the parties expressly choose English.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi arbitration centre default language is Arabic unless parties choose English.
